prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1024; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while turning left in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location where the collision occurred.

A: It was at a busy intersection in Katy, on a main road with a traffic signal. I was turning left into a shopping center.

Q: What was the signal showing when you began your turn?

A: It was a green arrow for me, I'm fairly sure. The oncoming traffic had a red light.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw headlights when I was partway through the turn, but I didn't have time to react before we hit.

Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?

A: The front passenger side of my car was hit by the other vehicle's front end.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My lower back hurts quite a bit. It feels tight and sore, especially when I sit for a long time or get up from a chair.

Q: Have you sought medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They examined me, took some X-rays, and told me I had a back strain. They gave me medication and told me to rest and do some gentle stretching.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I missed two days and I've been working lighter duties since then.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping to get my car repaired and my back feeling better.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
